How do I book a real appointment?

Call The Spoiled Pet Parlor at 916-420-3244. This website is a concept preview, and the wish-list planner does not send a request or reserve a time.

How much will my pet’s groom cost?

Call for an individual quote and to confirm available services. Size, coat, condition, and the style you’d like are useful details to have ready. Prices have not been supplied for this concept.

What if it’s their very first groom?

Mention that when you call. Share your pet’s age, breed, and anything you would like to discuss so the parlor can advise on a suitable first visit.

Do you groom cats or other pets?

Please call to confirm which pets the parlor welcomes. The dog portraits and example menu here illustrate a design direction; they don’t establish the full service list.

Where are you, and when are you open?

Call 916-420-3244 to confirm the location and hours. Those details will be added when they are available.
